Commentary.Commentary: This can be a tricky run chase now. The Indians are still favorites to overhaul the target, especially under lights where the ball is expected to skid onto the bat even more. The Windies bowlers have not had a great time so far but tonight is the day where they need to step up. Will India take an unassailable lead or will the Windies level the series? Join us in a while to find out.

Kuldeep Yadav gives a quick interview to Murali Kartik. He says that the wicket was good but there wasn't much turn like the last game. Adds that he just tried to bowl wicket-to-wicket line. On batsmen not picking him, he replies that he just keeps on mixing his variations. Also states that it's all about deceiving the batsmen in the air. Praises Shai Hope for his batting. Feels that it's difficult to adjust lengths while switching formats and reckons more you play, better you get.

The Indian bowlers were led by Bumrah. He was exceptional throughout as he finished with a 4-fer. Kuldeep too had a good day at the office. Chahal, Khaleel and Kumar though had a day to forget, especially Kumar, who was taken to the cleaners. Had these three bowled well, India would have been chasing something below 250.

Holder then along with Hope added a 76-run stand which steadied the ship. The latter continued but just when it was time for him to accelerate, he was dismissed by a beauty from Bumrah, 5 short of a ton. It would have been back-to-back tons for him. Ashley Nurse though came to the rescue and his cameo has given the Windies a total with which they can at least fight.

28 runs from the last two overs has seen the Windies finish with a competitive total on the board. Who would have thought they would cross the 280-run mark when they were reeling at 121-5. Their top order once again failed to make an impact. Hetmyer and Hope stitched another handy stand. The former was really hitting the ball well but lost his wicket at the wrong time.
A dot! No fifer for Bumrah. A yorker outside off, McCoy swings but misses. 7 from the last over AND WINDIES FINISH ON 283/9!
Obed McCoy is the last batsman. He has one ball left to face. Four? Six? Out? Dot? Or just a run or two?

OUT! As plumb as it gets! 4-fer for Bumrah. A yorker on middle, Nurse shuffles across and tries to flick but misses. The ball hits his boot. The players appeal and the umpire straightaway raises his finger. Nurse goes for the review but replays show three reds. Windies lose their review on the penultimate ball of the innings and Nurse walks back after playing a very good cameo. Bumrah now has one ball to get a fifer. Can he do so?
Howzzat? The umpire raises his finger. Nurse though reviews. Looks out to the naked eye.
BYE! Again makes room, Bumrah follows him. Roach connects with thin air and the batsmen steal a bye.

DROPPED! And to add salt to the wound it is a FOUR! A short ball around middle, Roach goes for the pull. The ball takes a top edge and goes towards fine leg. Kumar there makes good ground to his left and then dives but the ball bursts through his hands and trickles into the fence. Not Kumar's day today.
Dances down the track and eases it down to long on for a run.
Roach makes room and Bumrah follows him, the batter swings but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards third man, a leg bye taken.
FOUR! Perfect end to the over! 21 from it. They needed this especially after the last over. Nurse walks across and flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Roach does the right thing by giving the strike over to Nurse as he plays it to long on.
A yorker on middle, Nurse jams it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! 15 from the first 3. Full again and there is room on offer. Nurse has smashed it through covers and another boundary results. This is turning out to be a brilliant innings from Nurse.
WIDE! Pressure getting to Kumar. He bowls it way wide outside off.

FOUR! 10 from the first two! Pressure on the bowler! Nicely maneuvered. Very full and outside off, Nurse opens the face of the bat at the very last moment and guides it through backward point for a boundary.

SIX! All the way! That was right in the zone. Full and outside off, also it is the slower one. Nurse picks it and sends it sailing over the long on fence. Ideal start to the over, they need to make this a big one.
Make that 5, just 1 run from the 48th over. Another yorker and Roach can only dig it out.
Changes the length and bangs it short on middle, Roach defends it. 4 dots in a row.
Roach wants his bat to be changed here. The last ball must have done some damage.
Another yorker, not a lot you can do with those deliveries. Roach jams it out yet again.
Another slower one outside off, Roach jams it out.
Slower ball outside off, Roach is way too early into his shot and is beaten.
A low full toss on middle, Nurse hits it down to long on for a single.
A dot to end but a good over for the Windies. 10 from it. A slower ball on middle, kept out.
SIX! That is exactly what the doctor ordered! 250 up. On a length around off, Roach hits it over the long on fence for a biggie.
A slower ball on middle, it is clipped through square leg for a single. Need some boundaries, singles won't hurt India.
Back of a length around middle, Roach tries to work it across the line but he gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side for a single.
The slower ball on middle, Nurse goes for the heave but it goes off the inner half through square leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Roach guides it through point for a run.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
Finishes with a length ball on middle, Roach hits it down to long on and takes a run.
Wide! Down the leg side, it has been wided.
Back of a length on off, Roach guides it towards point. He wants a run but his partner is not interested.
The surprise bouncer there by Bumrah. However, it is a little too high and a wide is signaled.
A very full delivery on the pads, Roach tries to flick but misses.
Nurse dances down the track but is bowled a yorker. He jams it down to long off for a run.
Another slower ball around off, Roach opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point. The batsmen take a run.

Direct hit and Nurse was a goner! The slower ball on off, the ball is pushed towards Pant at covers. The batsmen set off for a run. Rishabh takes his time and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses by just.
So it stays 11 from the over as Roach defends the last ball out. The leggie is bowled out now, 10-1-56-1!
A single now as Nurse pushes it to covers. Smart batting as 10 already came off the over.
FOUR! Cut and cut hard! Chahal bowls it wider and shorter outside off, Nurse cuts it hard through point and the ball races away. So two dots to begin the over and the next two go for 10.
SIX! NAILED! A tossed up ball on middle, Nurse goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Nurse tries to cut but is beaten.
Flatter on middle, Nurse defends it.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back on.
Another yorker, Roach maybe was ready for it and somehow keeps it out.
Kemar Roach is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! A corker of a yorker from Bumrah. If there is one ball you do not want to be facing in your 90s, it is that one. It just does not get better than this. A toe-crusher on leg stump, Hope manages to get his boot out of the way but does not get his bat down in time. It sneaks through and hits the leg pole. Hope misses out on back-to-back tons and Windies' hope now of reaching a competitive total has just been dented big time.
Outside off, the batsman guides it through backward point for a run. So the Windies are dealing in singles at the moment. India won't mind this.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. They pick up a single.
Fuller in length on off, Nurse hits it down to long off for a run.
Starts off with a length ball which jags back in. Hope tries to keep it out but fails to do so. It hits him high on the pads and goes down to fine leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on. So he seems fine now.
A single to end the over as well through the covers.
Shortish again outside off, Nurse pushes it through covers for another run.
On a length around off, it is driven square on the off side for a run.
Serves a slower one on the pads, the batsman tucks it around the corner for a run.
Good length again around off, the batter blocks it out.
Slower ball to begin with on off, Hope drops it towards point and gets across for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
Eased through mid on to retain strike. Into the 90s.
On the stumps again and the batsman defends it out.
On the stumps, Hope has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Ashley Nurse's turn to bat.

OUT! Allen falls! So a short stay at the crease for the debutant. He goes for a big shot a little too early. Was not needed as there were still around 8 overs to go. Chahal does the smart thing as he tosses it above the eyeline. Allen's eyes lit up as he sees the flight and goes for the heave across the line. The ball takes the top edge and goes high up in the air towards long on. Pant there settles under it and takes it. He almost loses his balance after catching it but maintains it. First wicket for Chahal.
Down the leg side, Hope tries to flick but the ball brushes his pads and goes towards fine leg. Two leg byes taken.
Flatter and outside off, Hope cuts it but finds the point fielder.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back on.
Two dots to end his spell! He has been expensive today but has a wicket to his name. 10-0-65-1 is what his figures read. A length ball around off, kept out.
Closer to the off pole, kept out.

FOUR! Allen has played that fine! Outside off, Allen waits for it and then guides it through short third man. It is very fine and a boundary results. Not sure if he intended to play it that fine but he won't care.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Slightly shorter in length on the body, Allen goes for the pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Hope works it against the angle through mid-wicket. They run the first one hard and think about the second but opt against it.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring. Also, Khaleel Ahmed is back on.

Another loopy ball on off, Hope pushes it through covers and ends Powerplay 2 with a run. 164/4 is what they managed during this period. Also, end of Kuldeep for today, his figures reads 10-0-52-2. Once again has done a good job.
FOUR! Pierced the gap to precision! Tossed up outside off, Hope leans into it and times it through covers. No one in the deep so a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it up around off, Allen drives it down to long off and scores his FIRST ODI RUNS!
The googly around leg, the batsman works it around the corner for a run.

A big appeal but not given! Tossed up around off, it pitches and comes back in. Hope tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but not given. Spinning a little too much, the height also was an issue and Hawk Eye confirms that.
Now does the right thing by guiding it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Exqusite! Takes a few steps ahead and makes it into a half volley and strokes it through extra cover. The ball races away. 200 up for the Windies and Hope moves into the 80s.
On a length around middle, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Debutant Fabian Allen is the new batsman.

OUT! Holder holes out and it's a timely breakthrough for the Men in Blue. Kumar has struck early in this spell. A knuckle delivery, landing on a shortish length outside off, Holder shapes up for a big shot but mishits it high in the air towards long off. Jadeja (sub) moves forward a bit from the deep and takes the skier safely. End of a 76-run stand for Windies.
Back of a length delivery around off, Shai stands back and slaps it to deep cover for a run.
A length ball angling into the batsman, Hope flicks it off his pads but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back into the attack.
Tossed up ball on middle, tucked through mid-wicket for one.

Appeal for an lbw, not given! Flighted ball landing around off and turning back in, Hope gets forward and across to flick but misses. He is hit on the pads, they appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Maybe, spinning too much.
A googly on middle, turning away, Shai gets back and punches it down towards the bowler.
Beaten! Tossed up ball wide outside off, Hope tries to hit it over covers but fails to connect.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a run.
SIX! What a shot! This time by the Windies skipper. A flighted full ball around leg, a googly, Holder clears his front leg and heaves it over wide long on for a maximum. Pressing on the accelerator.

SIX! That has gone the distance! A slower one by Khaleel, full and around off, Shai picks it up early, takes his front leg away from the line and hoists it over the bowler's end. 11 from the over, a good one for the touring team.
Wide called for height as the attempted bounced by Ahmed goes over the batsman's head.
Lets out a grunt and bowls a full delivery on middle. Holder clips it straight to Rohit at mid-wicket who has a needless shy at the bowler's end. Another overthrow added to the total.
Just a bit short and around off, Shai guides it down to third man for a single.
Shortish and angling in around off, Hope turns it in front of square leg for nothing.
Physio comes out. Jasprit Bumrah seems to have hurt himself while fielding the ball. Maybe, he has pulled his calf muscle. Heading off to the pavilion.
Back of a length delivery outside off, a mistimed punch off the back foot by Hope and it goes a bit aerially towards mid off.

Lands it full and around off, Hope drives it towards mid off and scampers across to the other end. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end and with no one backing up, they take another run. A bit needless.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked off the pads to mid-wicket.
A silly mid on in place.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Beaten in flight there. This one spins back in after landing around off. Holder goes hard at it and chips it in the air. It goes safely through vacant mid off for a run.
Dropped! Floated and on off, forced back past the bowler and it was uppish. But Kuldeep failed to grab it in his followthrough. It rolled down to long on and they crossed.
Gets down on one knee for the sweep shot but fails to middle it properly. He hits it a shade uppishly but it doesn't carry to short fine leg.
Too full in length and on middle, it's driven down the ground to long on for a run.

Close! Holder works it towards mid on and sets off for a run. Chahal there is slow to the ball, he picks it up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Don't think it would have made a difference even if he had hit the stumps.
Swing and a miss! A ball outside off, Holder throws his bat at it and gets beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller in length around off, Hope pushes it towards mid off for a quick run.

SIX! Take that, says Shai Hope! A short ball and it sits up to be hit. Hope transfers his weight onto the back foot and then pulls it over the mid-wicket fence. Also the 50-run stand is up, another good one for the visitors but they would want this one to continue.
Good length again around off, the batter guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.

Flatter around off, Holder pushes it towards covers. He sets off for a run. Hope however, is not sure to go for it. A yes-no situation in the middle but the fielder fails to stop the ball and an easy run results.
Works it with the turn through mid-wicket for a single.
Once again goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the gloves.
Tossed up outside off and it comes back in. Hope pushes it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot! Goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine through the leg side. Kumar in the deep square leg region, runs to his right and puts in a dive but is not able to stop the ball.
On middle, Hope works it to mid-wicket.
Kuldeep Yadav returns.

Shortish outside off, Hope punches it through cover-point for a run. 50 up for Hope, his 7th in ODIs. He loves playing against India doesn't he? He though holds the key here for the Windies, needs to stay there till the end if the visitors are to reach a competitive total.
Another slower ball on off, Holder waits for it and the guides it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length on off, it is guided to point.
FOUR! Crunched! That made a cracking sound of the bat! Short and on middle, Holder goes back and pulls it all along the ground through mid-wicket for a boundary.
The seam-up delivery this time around off, Hope opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Starts off with a slower one on off, Holder guides it through backward point for a run.
Khaleel Ahmed is back on.
On the shorter side, Hope punches it hard but finds the man at covers.
Flatter on off, the batsman keeps it out off the back foot.
Another tossed up ball, kept out.
On the pads, worked down to long on for a run. 150 up for Windies.
Slower through the air on off, Hope plays it through cover-point for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Hope finds the cover fielder with a drive.
Beats the man at covers this time with a similar shot he played on the last ball for a brace.
Good length, Holder finds the fielder at covers.
BEATEN! Holder is going after Kumar here. He makes room and BK follows him. Holder tries to drive but is beaten on the inside.
Slightly shorter on middle, Hope pulls it all along the ground for a run.
Does the smart thing by easing it through mid on for a run.

In the air... but safe! Good effort from Bumrah but what kind of shot was that from Holder? Absolutely needless. He dances down the track and tries to clear mid on. Hits it off the higher portion of the bat and it goes high up in the air. Bumrah from that position backtracks and tries to take it but does not reach it. Two taken by the batsmen.
Drinks!
Another tossed up ball on off, played towards covers.
Flatter and around off, Hope goes back and defends it out.
A loopy ball this time and it pitches and turns. Holder does well to guide it through point for a run.
Slower through the air on middle, Holder drives it back to the bowler.
Works this against the turn through mid-wicket for a single.
On the shorter side, Hope pulls it down towards long on. Pant there fumbles and an extra run is taken.

A touch short and on middle, Holder turns it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A good comeback by Bhuvi after conceding a boundary first ball.
Lands it on a fuller length around off, Jason has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another watchful front foot defense by Holder.
Angling into the batsman around off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Fine shot! A full length ball on middle, Holder gets forward with a straight bat and caresses it straight back past the bowler. Chahal runs after the ball from mid off, tries his best to pull it back before the rope but fails in his attempt. A good start to the over for Windies.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.

Appeal for an lbw! Not given. A tossed up ball around middle, Hope gets forward to defend with his bat and pad together. Fails to block it out and is hit on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal. The replays later on show that it would have clipped the stumps. Anyway, India don't have any review left.
Hope has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Beauty of a delivery! Drifting into the batsman and landing around off. Hope is drawn forward in defense but it then spins away to beat the outside edge. Dhoni is quick to take the bails off but no appeal is made. Shai never left his crease.
Flighted and around leg, spinning towards off, Hope lunges and blocks it safely.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, Hope defends it back from the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
So after a long delay, Bumrah finally runs into bowl and he lands it on a length. Holder pushes it to covers.
Holder wants a change of helmet and finally the 12th man comes out with a new one. Also, the Windies players are wearing a black armband today as Sunil Ambris's dad expired two days back.
On the helmet! A good bumper on middle, it skids off the surface. Holder is late onto the pull and is hit on the helmet. He has helmet off, might have been broken.
Another short ball outside off, Holder punches it through covers for a single.
Back of a length on off, Holder plays a good looking punch through the off side for a single.
Good half-stop! Full and around off, it is hit towards covers. Kohli dives to his left and makes a half-stop. A run taken.
Back of a length around off, Hope defends it onto the ground.
Hope with the turn works it through square leg for a run.
Floats it up on off, defended off the front foot.
The leggie from outside off, it turns back in. Holder goes back and tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen run a leg bye.
The slider on middle, Holder goes back and keeps it out.
A full toss is eased down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Nicely played! Found the gap through the off side field and it races away. Floats it up outside off, Hope opens the face and hits it through cover-point for a boundary.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Guides this one down to third man and gets to the other end.
Good fielding by Pant! That was racing off the turf. Short and wide outside off, Holder cuts it through point. Pant from third man runs to his right, slides and keeps it down to one.
On the shorter side outside off, Hope guides it through point and takes a run.
Full and on middle, the batsman drives it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on. Going for the kill are India here.
Another dot to end. Holder pushes it to covers. Just a run and a wicket from the over.
Floats it up on off, Holder drives it to covers.
Jason Holder walks out to the middle. The skipper needs to lead from the front here.

OUT! This was on the cards, wasn't it? Powell was not comfortable playing Kuldeep and the left-arm spinner has got his man. Half the side back in the hut for the Windies. Another googly on middle, Powell does not pick it and goes for the heave. The ball turns away and that is what does him in. It takes the outside edge and goes in between Dhoni and Sharma at first slip. The latter reacts quickly, dives to his left and takes another sharp catch. Another failure for Rovman and the Windies are in deep trouble here.
On the shorter side, it is cut to point.
From around the wicket, tosses it up on off, it pitches and then turns away. Powell tries to block but is beaten.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for a run.
Slower ball on off, kept out.
A good bouncer! Powell is late on the pull and is beaten. Maybe was surprised by the change in length.
A big shot but the ball takes the outside edge and goes over point for a couple.
Back of a length around middle, kept out.
Shorter in length outside off, coming in with the angle. Powell tries to cut but gets beaten.
Fuller in length and outside off, it is driven to the man at sweeper cover for a run.
Picks the leggie this time and defends it by getting right behind the line.
The googly but it is short, so Powell can read it off the surface and defends it out.
Hope strokes it down to long off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floats it up outside off, Hope defends it out.
Tosses it up around off, Powell eases it down to long off for a run.
Extra bounce this time. On a good length around off, Hope is surprised by it and somehow keeps it out to covers.
Slower one, short and outside off, Shai turns it behind square leg without much time. It rolls there slowly and Dhawan is late to react. A couple of runs stolen.

Risky single! A length ball on off, Powell drops it with soft hands to the right of Rayudu at point. They take him on and Rovman completes the single as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Full and angling in on off, Rovman defends it off his front foot to the off side.
A touch short and outside off, Hope once again stands his ground and hits it through the line. This time he finds the gap through covers and picks a single.
Starts from 'round the wicket and angles in a length delivery on off. Shai defends it off his back foot to the off side.
Khaleel Ahmed is back on.

Beaten for the second time in a row! Powell just can't read which way the ball is turning. Another googly on off, Powell lunges and tries to keep it out but is beaten by the away turn. End of a brilliant over by Kuldeep.

BEATEN! Powell has no clue on which way the ball is turning. It is the googly and it is slightly fuller on off. Powell tries to read it off the surface as he goes back to defend. The ball though skids off and turns away and just before the bat can come down, Powell is beaten.
Another floated delivery, it is on the shorter side. Powell goes back and defends it.
Rovman Powell strides out to the middle.

OUT! Hetmyer's foot is on the line! Nelson strikes! Body blow to the Windies. Just as the partnership started to flourish, India have broken through. The crowd here erupts as they know how big this scalp is. India will be relieved to see the back of Shimron. A leg spinner from Kuldeep on off, this is slightly behind the length he has been bowling until now, so the ball gets enough time to turn. Hetmyer goes for the slog sweep after coming down the track a bit but is beaten by the away spin. Dhoni quickly whips the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs. Time for the replays and they show that Hetmyer has nothing behind the line. The youngster does not convert his start this time. India will now look to bring things under control once again.
Big moment in the game! An appeal for a stumping against Hetmyer has been taken upstairs.
Another tossed up ball on off, the batsman strokes it to covers.
SIX! And the flurry of boundaries continue! A juicy full toss on the pads, Hetmyer clears his front leg and tonks it over the mid-wicket fence.
Floats it up on off, kept out. So another good over for Windies, runs are flowing thick and fast here.

Comes from around the wicket and tosses it up outside off, Hetmyer strokes it to long off and gets to the other end. Also the 50-run stand is up. An important one as when the two came together, Windies were in trouble. Also, due to the rate they are scoring, Windies are in a good position at the moment. It has come up off just 34 balls.

SIX! Chahal has no answers to Hetmyer's aggressive batting! This is the quicker one on the pads, Hetmyer goes down on one knee quickly and then sweeps it over the square leg fence. Moves to 30 from 17 balls. 100 comes up for Windies.
Eases this down to long on and gets to the other end.
Another tossed up ball, Hope plays it with his bat in front of the pad.
Flatter outside off, Hope plays it to covers.
The leggie on middle, Hope tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg. The batsmen run a leg bye. Another good over, 8 from it and 21 off the last two.
Not got it right here, Kuldeep. Another short ball and way outside off, Hetmyer slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Too short and it has been put away! Hetmyer reads the turn, goes back and cuts it through point. Pant in the deep dives but his effort goes in vain.
Now it is short, Hope has time to go back and pull it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Again very full, not giving the ball a chance to turn. Hetmyer hits it towards cover. The fielder there makes a good stop but can't stop the single.
Very full on middle, Hetmyer jams it out towards covers.
A run to end the over! 13 from it, an expensive one. Hetmyer works it around the corner and gets to the other end.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
FOUR! 10 from the two balls. Hetmyer just like the last game is taking on Chahal. This is floated up on middle, SH powers it past the bowler and the it races to the fence.
SIX! Brute of a shot that! Chahal tosses it up outside off, enticing  the batsman to go for a biggie. Hetmyer obliges and hits it over mid off and over the fence.
Loopy ball on off, Hope gets to the pitch of it and times it through covers for a single.
On the pads, Hetmyer flicks it through square leg for a run.
A dot to end! Very full on off, Hope guides it to point.
The googly outside leg, Hope tries to sweep but the ball turns and hits the gloves of the batsman. Kuldeep starts appealing but then bails out.
Once again it is a flighted ball outside off, SH strokes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Plays the paddle sweep towards fine leg for a single.
Swept and swept nicely! Hope swipes it through short fine leg for a couple.
Gives it air on off, Hetmyer eases it down to long off for a run.
Kuledeep Yadav is into the attack.

SIX! Spoils what was a good over till then. A little too full by Chahal. Hope goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. No risk on that shot as the ball was very full and hence the spin is out of contention.
On off, defended.
Whips this down to long on now to change strike.
Slightly short and outside off, Hetmyer cuts but finds point. Should have got a run at least on that ball.
Around off and turning back in. Kept out.
A little too full on middle, Hetmyer works it with soft hands through square leg and runs brilliantly for a couple.

Drinks! So India on top at the moment. They have dismissed the top order of the Windies. The visitors though now have their two best batsmen of the series out there. They would dearly love another big partnership from them. India, on the other hand, will want to get these two back in the hut as early as possible.
Just enough to clear mid on! A short ball outside off, Hope tries to drag his pull but does not get it off the middle. It lobs over the mid on fielder and the batsmen get a brace.
Back of a length outside off, Hope guides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! A shot of a man in form! World class! Slightly short of a fuller length on off, Hope leans into it and strokes it on the up through extra cover for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Hope keeps it out.

Almost gets Shimron on the very first ball. A good length delivery around off, Hetmyer tries to guide it down to third man but the ball is a little too close to play that shot. He gets a bottom edge which goes closely past the off pole and down towards fine leg for a run which is also his 200th run in this series.
Shimron Hetmyer strides out to the middle. He has been in brilliant form and Windies would like another good innings from him.

OUT! Khaleel is all pumped up as he straightaway runs in joy. Big blow to Windies and the sorry form of Marlon Samuels continues. From 'round the wicket, Ahmed angles in a back of a length delivery around off. He gets it to straighten from there and Samuels is caught by surprise. Has a tame push inside the line and due to the extra bounce, he nicks it behind. Dhoni takes a fine low catch and Windies are three down.
Flatter and shorter in line of the stumps, Samuels goes deep inside the crease and slaps it to sweeper cover for one.
Flighted and on off, Hope uses his feet and drives it through mid off for one.
Eases a full ball through mid off and takes a single.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, Samuels defends it off his front foot.

Miscommunication but no harm done. Samuels gets forward and pushes a full ball gently to the off side. He initially looks for a run and Shai comes running down the track. Marlon sends him back as the throw is fired at his end. Chahal collects it but Hope dives to make it in safely.

FOUR! Begins the over well with a boundary. Flighted and full outside off, Samuels takes a stride forward and swats it through covers for a boundary. Kuldeep in the deep wasn't quick enough to get to the ball.
Yes, he has! A single to end it as Marlon guides it down to third man.
Five dots! So this is a good over by Khaleel. Can he end it well though?
Another length ball outside off, Samuels guides it towards point. He wants a run but seeing Pandey get to the ball quickly. The non-striker sends Marlon back.
Closer to the off pole. Kept out.
Length again outside off, left alone.
Back of a length outside off, left alone.
Bowls a flatter delivery to end the over. Hope blocks it out.
Even more turn this time! He lands it around leg, it pitches and then turns away. Hope tries to work it on the leg side but gets hit on the glove. So, encouraging signs these for Chahal, Kuldeep too.
Good delivery! Gives it air and lands it around off, Hope lunges and blocks it out. A little turn there for Chahal.
Floated up a little too full, Samuels eases it down to long off for a single.
Flatter around off, MS pushes it towards covers.
Tosses it up around middle, Samuels lunges and keeps it out.
Powerplay 2 signalled. Now, a maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. There is a bowling change too. Yuzvendra Chahal to bowl his leggies. A slip in place...

BEAUTY! To end the over... Needs to bowl more of these. Angles this into the batter first which means Hope has to play. Gets it to leave him after pitching which beats the outside edge of Hope's willow as he tries to defend.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
From around the wicket he bowls it on a length. Hope awkwardly play it towards covers.

FOUR! Hope once again looks in great touch here. A back foot punch, one of the toughest shots to play and he has done it with ease. Slightly shorter and outside off, SH stands tall and punches it through covers for a boundary. Not good bowling this by Khaleel, at his pace, this length, just won't work.
Strays on the pads, Hope flicks it through square leg for a brace.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.

NOT OUT! It is missing the stumps! Excellent use of the review there by Samuels and the on-field call has to be overturned. Bumrah lands it on a length around middle, Samuels is on his toes as he tries to flick. Misses to get hit high on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire agrees. Samuels walks to his partner and then signals the 'T'. Replays show that the ball is going over the stumps. Marlon survives to fight another day.
Have India got another? Samuels has been given LBW but he has taken the review. It might just clip the stumps. The on-field call might just play a role here.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They have run through for a single.

Another outside edge but this one is short! Around off and on a length. Hope tries to defend but gets an outside edge which falls just short of second slip. Hope played that with soft hands and hence the ball did not carry.
Full and on middle, Hope pushes it to mid on.
Samuels is underway straightaway! He pushes it towards mid on and gets across to the other end.
Marlon Samuels is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! What a masterstroke by the Indian skipper there. He changed ends for Bumrah and it has worked wonders. Once again it is a delivery which is slightly short. He hit the deck hard on that one and gets extra bounce. It angles away too to open the batsman in his stance. Powell tries to defend it off the back foot but the ball takes the outside edge and flies towards Rohit Sharma at widish first slip. He takes a sharp catch stretching towards his right. Both the openers back in the hut without making an impact again. Second wicket for Bumrah.
Change of ends for Jasprit Bumrah.
A single to end a good over for the Windies. 11 form it. This is tucked towards wide mid on for a single.
FOUR! An expensive start by Ahmed here. Another poor ball, on the pads, easy pickings for Powell. He flicks it over square leg and into the fence.
Again on a length and around off, Powell strokes it to covers.
Slightly fuller in length on off, Powell strokes it to mid off.
SIX! All the way! That was right in the zone for Powell. Short and outside off, Powell is quick to rock onto the back foot and then pull it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Starts off well with a length ball around off, it pitches and shapes away. Powell plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Khaleel Ahmed is into the attack.
Back of a length again around off, Hope guides it to point. Three dots to end another good over for India.
Good length again around off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Length ball around off, Hope guides it towards point and wants a run but is sent back.
On middle, Powell tries to flick but he gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg for a run.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Hope, the centurion of the last game, is off the mark as he flicks it down to fine leg.
BEATEN! So a dot to end an action-packed over. 10 runs and a wicket from it. Back of a length outside off, Powell hangs hit bat out and gets beaten.
Shai Hope is the new batsman.

OUT! In the air... and what a catch by Dhoni. WOW! Bumrah has the last laugh but a lot of credit has to be given to MS for this wicket. Bumrah bangs this one short. He bends his back on this one as it skids through and also gets big on the batsman. Hemraj goes for the pull but is late on the shot. The ball takes the top edge and lobs towards short fine leg. For a moment, Hemraj must have felt he would get away with this but NO. Dhoni makes good ground to his right, then dives full stretch and takes it in front of the fine leg fielder who has also come in. Hemraj stands there in disbelief and then starts walking back. However, the umpires ask him to wait as they want to check if the catch is clean and the replays show, it is as clean as a whistle. CH has to continue walking and India get an early breakthrough.

SIX! Stand and deliver! What a shot that! Nothing wrong with the delivery. Slightly shorter in length around off, Hemraj picks the length early and then pulls it over the long on fence for a biggie. 10 from 2 balls. That boundary probably must have broken the shackles.
FOUR! Up and over! A much-needed boundary! Full and outside off, Hemraj tries to go over covers but he ends up slicing it over cover-point and the ball trickles into the fence.
Almost played it on! Good length and outside off, Hemraj tries to push at it away from his body but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Another appeal but once again the ball has pitched outside leg. Full and around leg, Hemraj tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Bumrah starts appealing but then bails out.
A dot to end! Around off, Powell tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Just 4 from the over. A watchful beginning from Windies here.
Goes for a yorker but ends up serving a low full toss. Powell strokes it to mid on.
Good length on middle, defended.
Slightly straighter in line and Powell flicks it through square leg for a brace.
A slower bouncer on the body of the batsman. Hemraj waits for it and then pulls it towards fine leg for a run.
In the air but away from the fielder. On a length around off, Powell tries to drive it on the up but it goes away from the fielder at covers and towards wide mid off for a run.

NOT OUT! And it has pitched way outside leg. A poor review by India. Bumrah bowls it on a length around leg, Hemraj goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Virat Kohli after a chat with Dhoni and Bumrah goes for the review. Replays roll in and they show that the ball has pitched outside leg. That is that then. India lose their sole review and very early into the game. After watching the replays on the giant screen, even Kohli fails to hide his smile.
Review time! An appeal for an LBW has been turned down. Hemraj is the man in question. Pitching seems to be an issue.
Back of a length on middle, Hemraj defends it towards cover-point. He wants a run but is sent back.
Good zip there off the surface for Bumrah! Full and way outside off, Hemraj tries to force it through the off side but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Now plays a solid looking drive towards mid off and takes a quick run.
BEATEN! Once again a loose shot by Powell. A delivery pitched just ahead of a shorter length outside off. Powell hangs his bat out, maybe trying to guide it down to third man but gets beaten.
On the pads, Powell fails to flick and gets hit on the pads. An ambitious appeal follows but not given. Pitching outside leg.
6 from Kumar's second! On a length and around off, blocked.

First signs of aggression there by Hemraj. He dances down the track but a little too early. Kumar bangs it short but it is down the leg side. CH goes for the pull but misses. Kumar puts in an appeal to distract the umpire. However, he is not and signals a wide.
A little too straight this time, Hemraj flicks it but finds mid-wicket. He will be a touch disappointed there as he could have fetched a few runs there.
Again, on middle, it is played towards mid-wicket.
Like this! Attacks the middle pole, Hemraj defends it out.

FOUR! Hemraj too is off the mark with a boundary! Short and outside off, not the best of deliveries. Hemraj puts it away with a punch off the back foot through cover-point and the ball races away. Needs to keep it on the stumps on this wicket. There is hardly any swing on offer and the ball is coming onto the bat really well.
On the fuller side around off, Powell times it towards mid off and scampers through for a run.
A good nut to end the over! A maiden. Length and around off, pitches and shapes away. Hemraj plays inside the line and lets it go.
Once again so accurate is Bumrah. He comes running in and lands it on a length and around off, giving no room to the batsman. All Hemraj can do is block it out.
On the shorter side, skids off the surface. CH stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
A stifled appeal but not given! A length ball around middle, it pitches and comes back in. Hemraj tries to defend but he gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Low bounce on this one though! Around off, Hemraj makes a leave and it goes on the bounce to Dhoni who does not collect it cleanly.
Good bounce there! Bumrah bangs it on a length and around off, Hemraj is on his toes as he defends that one.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
So just the boundary from the first over. On a length around off, kept out.

BEATEN! A loose shot there! Good use of the angle by Kumar. He lands it slightly shorter and around off, it goes away with the angle. Powell throws his bat at it away from his body but luckily for him, he gets beaten. Such shots so early in the innings, just not needed.
Bowls it on off and a touch fuller. Powell pushes it to mid on.

FOUR! Opens the account with a boundary! Slightly straighter, no swing on this one. Powell flicks it through mid-wicket. The outfield here is lightning fast and the ball races away for a boundary. A good way to score the first runs of the innings.
Attacks the stumps this time and once again gets some shape away. Powell gets right behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out.
Starts off with a good delivery. On a length and around off, a little shape away from the batsman. Powell defends it towards covers.

We are all set for the action to begin. Out come the Indian players along with the umpires. They are followed by the Windies openers Kieran Powell and Chandrapaul Hemraj. The former will be on strike and he will face and he will face Bhuvneshwar Kumar who will bowl with the first new ball. Two slips in place for him. Here we go...
Windies (Playing XI) - Kieran Powell, Chandrapaul Hemraj, Shai Hope(w), Marlon Samuels, Shimron Hetmyer, Rovman Powell, Jason Holder(c), Fabian Allen, Ashley Nurse, Kemar Roach, Obed McCoy.
India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma, Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli(c), Ambati Rayudu, MS Dhoni(w), Rishabh Pant, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Kuldeep Yadav, Jasprit Bumrah, K Khaleel Ahmed, Yuzvendra Chahal.

Jasprit Bumrah is giving an interview to Laxman Sivaramakrishnan. He says that it feels good to get back from a break. Adds that he made sure to train during the break and work on his skills. Hopes to generate good movement going forward. Mentions that he is not looking too far and is taking one game at a time. States that he is not trying to develop anything new but wants to deliver the way team wants him to.

Windies' skipper, Jason Holder says it is a good pitch to bat on and they would like to put runs on the board. Mentions he would have liked to bowl first but the toss is not in his hands. States they have to continue to be consistent with the bat and hope their bowlers do well. Informs they have one change as Bishoo misses out and Allen will make his debut.

India's skipper, Virat Kohli says it looks a good wicket and he reckons it plays a little slower in the daytime. Mentions bringing back key players was always the plan with the World Cup in mind. Adds further, they strengthen the bowling attack even more. Informs they have three changes, Umesh, Jadeja and Shami go out and Bumrah, Kumar and Ahmed replace them.
Toss - Up goes the coin and Holder calls it wrong. India elect to bowl.

PITCH REPORT - Murali Kartik and Sunil Gavaskar are conducting the pitch report. The Little Master points that since the curator here has been a bowler himself, he has left some grass on the pitch. He reckons that it will assist the fast bowlers early on but once the seam will flatten out, run-scoring will get easier. They are once again expecting a 300-plus game.

A victory for India in the first ODI, a tie in the second. What do we have in store for his in the third? Can the Windies level the series with a win here today? One can surely not rule them out after their performance in the last game. The hosts on the other side, have strengthened their squad by getting in their first-choice bowlers. They are once again heavy favorites heading into the game. Virat Kohli will hope to take an unassailable lead here today. welcome to the coverage.
